The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

results.content:
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
0007-cart-item-limit.md

steps.reasoning_content: The Northwind 60-line cap no longer applies since that contract ended in October, and our warehouse has no line limit, so the config and design doc's 100 stands. I'm recording that decision and marking ADR 0007 as superseded.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Resolves: issue #12. Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order (contract section 4). Since 2025-11-01 fulfilment is done from our own warehouse, which has no per-order line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md), so the reason for 60 is gone. Commit 271cecb raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md after 40 support inquiries (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md; requested sizes median 80, max 100), but ADR 0007 was left saying 60.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default: 100`) and docs/design/cart.md already match. ADR 0007 is marked superseded.

## Consequences
Any future fulfilment partner with a line cap must be checked against this limit.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md (2026-11-01); originally accepted 2024-09-02/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
git add -A && git commit -qm "decisions: cart item limit is 100, supersede ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere, and the decision is recorded. I committed it as `fd619ff` on master. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

**What was inconsistent:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` said 100, but ADR 0007 still said 60.

**Why 100:**
- **Cause of the old limit:** ADR 0007 set 60 because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines.
- **Cause is gone:** That contract ended on 2025-10-31. Our own warehouse has no per-order line limit.
- **Customer demand:** 40 support inquiries asked for larger carts, with a median of 80 and a maximum of 100.

**Changes:**
- **New decision record:** `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md` records the decision and the reasoning above.
- **ADR 0007:** I changed its status line to "Superseded by" the new record. I left the rest of the ADR as it was.
- **Config and design doc:** Neither needed changes.

If we sign another fulfilment partner with a line cap, it will need checking against 100.
